task: put the bowl on top of the cabinet

windows.text: Reach the open gripper horizontally across the table toward the bowl.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper toward its rim.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Grasp the bowl from above, closing the gripper fingers around its rim.
Grasp the bowl on the table and lift it upward.
Lift the bowl up off the table, raising it beside the dark bottle.
Lift the bowl up off the table, raising it above the surface beside the dark cabinet.
Carry the bowl horizontally over the table toward the dark cabinet.
Grasp the bowl by closing the gripper fingers around its rim as it is positioned over the cabinet.
Release the bowl onto the top of the cabinet and open the gripper.
Release the bowl onto the top of the cabinet and retract the empty gripper upward.
Hold the open gripper stationary above the bowl resting on the cabinet.
